purpose: Prepare one exact minimal read-only live package for the already synthetic-PASS B13-C health adapter so the next action can be presented as a concrete T3 user gate. Do not deploy or read live collector state.
requirements: Freeze the least-privilege host interface needed for exactly one bounded get_health() call against the fixed state path and fixed systemd unit.
Expose no arbitrary path, service name, shell command, log content or raw state JSON.
Freeze exact deployment artifact hashes, ownership/mode expectations, rollback procedure and one bounded live-read invocation.
Live output must remain exactly the adapter allowlist and evidence_eligibility must remain NOT_EVALUATED.
Separate the future T3 actions explicitly: host installation of the read-only interface and the first live collector-state read.
Provide offline/static validation of the package without touching live state.
terminal_rule: Persist and verify the exact package/freeze, revalidate current main, then one TERMINAL RECEIPT with CONTINUATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED: true and STRATEGY_REVIEW_REQUIRED: false. The only valid continuation after READY is USER_GATE_REQUIRED. Stop.
allowed_pr_writes: worker progress comments only when required by canonical worker instructions
